overview.description: The Bitwise Hyperliquid ETF Common Shares of Beneficial Interest (BHYP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long hype, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed ETP that offers direct exposure to Hyperliquid (HYPE) while also seeking to earn additional HYPE from staking rewards. BHYP was launched on May 14, 2026 and is issued by Bitwise.
